notes.title: November Murderous Pursuits Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers, [/h1]

We’re bringing you another Murderous Pursuits update fixing various issues you may have come across during your time with MP so far. 

If you have any feedback or any issues, send us an email to support@blazinggriffin and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support and enjoy!

:MPReveal: Find us on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/murderouspursuits]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/MurderPursuit]Twitter[/url] :MPReveal:

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[b]Gameplay Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Subvert now results in all negatives being removed for Victim (including Disrupt and Flash).
[*] Fixed kill streak bonuses for pie bomb kills.
[*] Killing with Chameleon Perk now adds kill to original Character.
[*] Fixed Hunter Stun when Disguised showing weapon after changing back to original Character.
[*] Changed Russian font to make text easier to read at smaller sizes.
[*] Capture Point Spawn Warning changed from 30 to 60.
[*] Score Panel message changed for Elimination to include countered by Quarry or Hunter.
[/list]

[b]Settings and Memory:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new "Ultra Low" option in settings.
[*] Added "quality" command line option to start game with that quality setting (e.g. "-quality 0" for lowest).
[*] All supported screen resolutions and aspect ratios are now allowed.
[*] Reduced texture memory usage for various UI objects.
[/list]

[b]Crash Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed various Server and Client crashes.[/list]

Happy Hunting!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i] :MPPies:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/c6836212b570222a398f7529a42ffb9407aae21f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Thank you for joining us on during the weekend!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers (both new and old),[/h1] 
 
Over the weekend we hosted a promotion to allow you to jump into the antics of Murderous Pursuits! As a small indie developer, we had no idea the response that we would get from the promotion – we hit number 4 on concurrent players on Steam on Saturday! We are so humbled and thankful to all those who gave the game a go and are continuing to do so, and please bear with us while we come to terms with the numbers who are now playing the game!
 
If you missed out on a chance to grab the game during the weekend, you can pick it up on Humble Bundle for free with any purchase, check out the deal [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/promo/halloween-sale/]here.[/url]

If you’ve enjoyed the game, our DeluXe pack is now 50% off on Steam which includes an exclusive artbook, wallpapers, taunts and skins. 
 
If you want to become a member of the Discord community, join us [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/murderouspursuits]here.[/url]
 
You can also find us on:

:MPDisguise: [url=https://twitter.com/MurderPursuit]Twitter[/url]
:MPQuarry: [url=https://www.facebook.com/MurdrousPursuits/]Facebook[/url]
:MPReveal: [url=https://www.instagram.com/murderous_pursuits/]Instagram[/url]
 
[h1][i]We’re aware that with so many new players a few issues have come up throughout this weekend.[/i][/h1]
 
[b]Crashes:[/b] If you’re having issues with crashing can you please send your output and crash logs (located in the MurderousPursuits_Data file) to support@blazinggriffin.com. We’ve currently got quite a few emails to go through so please bear with us as we try to get to the bottom of what each of you may be facing.

[b] Port Forwarding/Opening Ports/Nat Strict:[/b] Please have a look at this guide: https://steamcommunity.com/app/638070/discussions/0/1696045708647346901/
If you want to play with friends, you can also use the party function located below your user profile on the top righthand side of the main menu.
 
We will continue to look into other issues mentioned on the discussion boards and reviews over the coming days.

Thank you again for joining us during the free weekend and we hope you’re here to stay. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/338d61dd9873a9c3d734961ae8d8df70ccc5fadd.gif[/img]
 
[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i] :MPPies:

notes.title: Elimination Update
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE NOTES 1.6.0[/h1] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/f704879575b22869796402c7bed8257c156e867a.gif[/img]

[b]CHANGES[/b]

Elimination Game Mode

[list]
[*]Capture points now spawn into the level.
[*]Successfully capturing the capture point will kill all other active players.
[*]Disabled the AFK kick when Spectating.
[*]When entering spectate mode you should spectate the player who killed you.
[*]Increased sole survivor bonus from 5 to 10.
[*]Enabled Chat in Spectate mode.
[/list]

Player Profile
[list]
[*]Decreased number of games to be completed before receiving a ranking from 10 to 5.
[*]Player statistics will now display the precise world ranking.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Pie Bomb hunter stuns displaying incorrect favour value.
[*]Fixed players that have left a game from appearing in the active player list.
[*]Fixed directional force applied to characters when attacked from behind.
[*]Fixed the skybox on RCS Laboratory not being visible on the winner screen.
[*]Fixed the size of the button colliders when leaving a Party.
[*]Fixed the Preset confirmation panel not closing when clicking another part of the screen.
[*]Fixed How to Play not defaulting to the first page.
[*]Fixed hover-over SFX not playing when highlighting Calling Cards.
[*]Fixed the Esc Menu open VFX playing during loading screens.
[/list]

notes.title: Murderous Pursuits September Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/ff749378f9519d0263a2e3a9e5c1b006161e8ce6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers,[/h1]

Welcome back! This month we’re giving you another glimpse into the wondrous time warping HMCS Britannic with our new map, adding more ammunition to your abilities roster and more faces board the ship.

Let us know your thoughts below ːsteamhappyː

Thanks for your support over the last few months and enjoy!

[h1]RELEASE NOTES 1.5.0[/h1]
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]
 
[b]Arboretum Level[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/270a7b6c80cd3267648ac68dd4d4eed98037cf5c.gif[/img]

The Arboretum of H.M.C.S Britannic provides a tranquil haven for the aristocrats looking for an escape from the more unsavoury types while also providing a space for horticultural specimens and research.
 
[b]Pie Bomb Ability[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/e333329aa4a6f261995f62f2d01a5798e5325f5d.gif[/img]

Place a deliciously deadly trap that will explode when a Quarry or Hunter approaches it.
 
[b]New Characters[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/ecd6b8c39d8120fe26ece060e0d80811af2c3f13.gif[/img]

Four new characters have boarded the ship and are ready to kill their way to the top! Introducing the Widow, Gentleman, Gokudo and Adventurer.
 
[b]New Perks[/b]
Use Nimble to close the gap on your prey with increased fast walk and run speeds or keep track of them with Determined, increasing your target lock time for targets that goes out of sight.
 
[b]New Achievements and Calling Cards[/b]
We’ve added 38 new achievements and 25 new calling cards for you to customise your player profile with.
 
[b]CHANGES[/b]
 
Targeting Improvements
[list]
[*]Targeting highlight now has a short delay before removing itself when a target is deselected.
[*]Players can no longer be highlighted when they are being arrested, attacked or attacking.
[*]Over-the-shoulder zoom occurs when target lock is activated.
[*]Target lock reticule repositioned.
[*]Target lock icon added to the HUD.
[/list]
 
Kill Impact
[list]
[*]Field of View change occurs when making a valid attack.
[*]VFX for frontal attacks and backstabs have been improved.
[*]VFX added to the backhanded hunter slap.
[*]VFX added to stunned hunters.
[*]VFX added to players that have been killed.
[*]VFX added when corpses despawn.
[*]Screen desaturation effect added when player has been killed.
[*]Screenshake added to backstab attacks.
[*]Ragdoll forces have been improved.
[/list]
 
Kill Messaging
[list]
[*]Primary messages now show the type of kill that the player has made.
[*]Score breakdown after a successful kill now shows one at a time rather than all in one panel.
[*]Kill from a vignette bonus has been renamed ‘Ambush’.
[*]Kill from with a backstab bonus has been renamed ‘Backstab’.
[*]Kill with an ability bonus has been renamed ‘Used Ability’.
[*]Kill an exposed quarry bonus has been renamed ‘Quarry Exposed’.
[/list]
 
Vignettes
[list]
[*]Players now appear as a grey question mark on the hunter indicator when in a vignette, hiding the ‘hunter near’ status from their quarry.
[*]A short buffer period has been added to the ‘Ambush’ bonus so that players are still awarded it if they move before making the kill.
[/list]
 
Unlocking Skins
[list]
[*]1st character skin unlock favour reduced from 250 to 100.
[*]2nd character skin unlock favour reduced from 500 to 250.
[*]3rd character skin unlock favour reduced from 1000 to 500.
[*]4th character skin unlock favour reduced from 2500 to 750.
[/list]
 
Unlocking Characters
[list]
[*]Initial character unlock favour reduced from 5000 to 1000.
[/list]
 
Unlocking Taunts
[list]
1st taunt unlock favour reduced from 25 wins to 10 wins.
2nd taunt unlock favour reduced from 50 wins to 25 wins.
[/list]
 
Unlocking Perks
[list]
[*]Chameleon unlock level increased from 6 to 16.
[*]Resourceful unlock level increased from 16 to 22.
[*]Gambler unlock level increased from 22 to 39.
[/list]
 
Unlocking Abilities
[list]
[*]Counter unlock decreased from level 4 to level 19.
[*]Flash unlock decreased from level 8 to level 34.
[*]Humiliate unlock decreased from level 13 to level 25.
[*]Disrupt unlock decreased from level 19 to level 4.
[*]Subvert unlock decreased from level 25 to level 13.
[/list]
 
Ability Balances
[list]
[*]Increased duration of Reveal from 8 to 10 seconds.
[*]Increased duration of Disrupt from 5 to 8 seconds.
[*]Reduced duration of Disguise from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*]Reduced cooldown of Disrupt from 60 to 45 seconds.
[*]Reduced cooldown of Subvert from 75 to 60 seconds.
[*]Reduced time it takes to Reveal targets from 0.75 to 0.5 seconds.
[*]Reduced amount of Exposure increase while Humiliating.
[*]Flash will no longer cancel Disguise.
[/list]
 
Scoring Balances
[list]
[*]Decreased backstab bonus from 5 to 4.
[*]Increased ambush bonus from 4 to 5.
 [/list]
 
XP Balances
[list]
[*]Reduced most kills and most stuns XP reward from 1000 to 500.
[*]Increased first game of the day XP reward from 2000 to 3000.
[*]Reduced XP scaling per level from 1000 increase to 500 increase.
[/list]
 
Kairos Rank Balances
[list]
[*]Initiate rank range has been changed from 0-800 to 0-1300
[*]Disciple rank range has been changed from 800-1200 to 1300-1500
[*]Acolyte rank range has been changed from 1200-1600 to 1500-1700
[*]Chosen rank range has been changed from 1600-2000 to 1700-1900
[*]Master rank range has been changed from 2000-2400 to 1900-2100
[*]Grandmaster rank range has been changed from 2400+ to 2100+
[/list]
 
Misc
[list]
[*]Added new music tracks.
[*]Reduced the end game score screen timer from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.
[/list]
 
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed locked Perks not being visible in the lobby.
[*]Fixed skulls on the scoreboard during Elimination games not updating.
[*]Fixed camera controls becoming inverted after death.
[*]Fixed camera clipping issues with NPCs.
[*]Fixed some audio issues in the Library level.
[*]Fixed Chrono Capacitor spelling error.
[*]Fixed confetti VFX appearing at the bottom of the screen when a game starts.
[*]Fixed initially spawning as a different character when joining mid-game with Chameleon equipped.
[*]Fixed issue where Disrupt VFX was not looping correctly.
[*]Fixed issue where Disrupt effect time was incorrect for bots.
[*]Fixed graphical glitch with the Assassin's mouth.
[*]Fixed death camera focussing on the wrong corpse after being killed twice in quick succession.
[*]Fixed wrong information being displayed on pop-up when attempting to create a Public game with no password.
[*]Fixed pull out weapon animation from triggering on the game over screen.
[*]Fixed "Your Quarry [Player] has left the game" message not being shown.
[*]Fixed "minutes" not being displayed on the setting for Elimination round length.
[/list]

Happy Hunting!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i]

notes.title: Murderous Pursuits August Update and Free Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/245cf8cbe0cd6589e1a5f0feaae39573d6042d45.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers,[/h1]

We’re just the gift that keeps on giving, today we bring you our next monthly update with more content to keep the boredom blues away. This month we're giving you a brand new map, elimination game mode, new abilities and MORE!

Murderous Pursuits is also hosting a free weekend on Steam, so grab a mate and hop aboard the HMCS Britannic. 

[i]Free Weekend Start Time: Thurs 2nd August 10AM PT / 6PM BST

Free Weekend End Time: Sun 5th August 1PM PT / 9PM BST[/i]

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

 
[h1]PATCH NOTES 1.4.0[/h1]
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]
 
[b]The Library[/b]
In this new level, explore the vast collection of ancient books Mr. X has gathered from throughout time. Perhaps he will use them to rewrite history...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/ba87884feaab3747f246ead5bc606e836eb7ec40.gif[/img]
 
[b]Elimination[/b]
In this game mode, only the cunning will prevail. Find and kill other players while avoiding being killed yourself, because once you're killed - you're out.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/4187ba5f830ab3abbd3a867b72887fee7e476a8c.gif[/img]

[b]Subvert Ability[/b]
Level the playing field with Subvert. Clear all ability effects in the area and prevent anyone from using abilities for a short period.
 
[b]New Model Swaps[/b]
The Privateer and Saurian Hunter have arrived on-board and are ready to do X's dirty work.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/47f7785d0f43698a04c51443a75b5d9129f6cb94.gif[/img]
 
[b]Backstab[/b]
You can now sneak up behind unsuspecting Quarries and deliver a deadly surprise.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/62bc11407fc958ff0409492a9a61b51f7cf9dc15.gif[/img]

[b]Humble Pie Hunter Stun (DeluXe DLC)[/b]
Knock your Hunter down a peg or two with several slices of humble pie.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/799ac35fb973b37596c3e5ac5542d7b26dfa9a5b.gif[/img]
 
[b]CHANGES[/b]
 
Pull Out Weapon
Players will now reach for their weapon when attempting to make an attack without a target, increasing their exposure and preventing them from attacking for a short period.
 
Player Names in Messages
Player names have been added to Mr. X's in-game messages, so you know which ne’er-do-well you are dealing with.
 
Abilities
[list]
[*]Reduced Disrupt cooldown from 90 to 60 seconds.
[*]Increased the time Reveal lasts from 5 seconds to 8 seconds.
[/list]
 
NPCs
[list]
[*]Balanced amount of NPCs in all levels.
[/list]
 
Bonus Points
[list]
[*]Increased Hidden in Vignette bonus from 3 favour to 4 favour.
[*]Decreased Kill with Ability bonus from 3 favour to 2 favour.
[*]Decreased Kill Exposed Quarry from 3 favour to 1 favour.
[/list]
 
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed levels not loading correctly on intial attempt.
[*]Fixed spawning next to other players in Free-For-All mode.
[*]Fixed receiving an "Invalid Target" message when attacking a legitimate target.
[*]Fixed missing SFX when Disguise expired.
[*]Fixed issue where Disrupt VFX would follow user for a short period.
[*]Fixed Fistycuffs weapon not being aligned correctly in the character's hand.
[*]Fixed controller UI not being used on the HUD when using a gamepad.
[*]Fixed being unable to Humiliate the Soothsayer.
[*]Fixed vignette animations being interrupted when pressing keys in the Esc menu.
[*]Fixed Resourceful Perk not affecting some Ability cooldown values correctly.
[*]Fixed HUD elements remaining on screen when killed near the end of a game.
[*]Fixed overlapping text in the lobby.
[*]Fixed some localisation issues.
[/list]

Happy Hunting!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i]

notes.title: It's heating up in Update 1.3.0...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/96deb3ccecded7d3dc4538a13c14b36a6b1fdc57.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers,[/h1]

Grab your weapons and brace yourselves, our third update has landed! From an additional game mode to a brand new perks system, Update 3 provides you with an even fuller Murderous Pursuits experience and more ways to impress Mr. X

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]PATCH NOTES 1.3.0[/h1]
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]

[b]Chrono Capacitor Level[/b]
Deep down in the Brittanic's underbelly is the Chrono Capacitor, the technological marvel that allows the ship to travel through time itself. What better spot for some murderous fun?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/ac18530c407480a40db6013445e9e7ef664e3515.gif[/img]
 
[b]Free-For-All game mode[/b]
Mr X has grown weary of simply giving you one quarry to kill to satisfy his bloodlust, but be cautious as everyone else now also has their eye on you... Free-For-All mode makes all players in the game a valid target!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/239c10072bb3699c457f5abb6b4b00d1fdb5fa5f.gif[/img]
 
[b]Target Lock[/b]
You asked for it, you got it! Lock on to other players from distance or in a crowd using the right mouse button, so your killing blow no longer finds an unwanted target.
 
[b]Perks System[/b]
Perks will passively alter how your game plays, from always spawning with a 5 favour weapon to respawning as a random character whenever you are killed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/daef2911b5f2e48c47bca340824470b13db49e7e.png[/img]
 
[b]Disrupt Ability[/b]
Scramble the HUD of nearby players so they won't see you coming with this devilishly delightful new ability.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/5a52de12477dd870feea5725101c0d00833bbde8.gif[/img]
 
[b]New Model Swaps[/b]
Introducing the Soothsayer and Moujik on board H.M.C.S. Brittanic to enjoy the sights and sounds only a humungeous time traveling flying ship can provide. Well... until you murder them, of course.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/f23c17c1a31b2da37268780cd4dd2956cb97cc59.gif[/img]
 
[b]CHANGES[/b]

Abilities
[list]
[*]Disguise: Activating no longer fully decreases the player's Exposure.
[*]Disguise: Whenever a Hunter uses Disguise, their Quarry's ‘Hunter Near’ HUD indicator changes to a 'Disguised' version.
[*]Disguise: Cooldown increased from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
[*]Reveal: Cooldown reduced from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.
[/list]
 
XP and Achievements
[list]
[*]Players can unlock new items, increase XP and unlock achievements in Custom Games.
[*]Custom Games can be made public to all players.
[*]Set player level cap to 250
[*]Reduced XP required for first level from 12000 to 6000
[*]Reduced the max XP per level required from 50000 to 20000
[*]Increased position XP rewards by 1000
[*]Set first game of the day bonus to 3000
[*]Set consecutive match reward to 3000
[/list]
 
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Humiliation occasionally not being able to be used on a killed Quarry.
[*]Fixed online games not being created when connection to a dedicated server failed.
[*]Fixed players being able to connect to different versions of the game.
[*]Fixed NPCs not applying the same character/skin combination as players.
[*]Fixed Humiliation not deactivating Disguise.
[*]Fixed Price win taunt clipping with coat prop on Backstage.
[*]Fixed Brute win taunt clipping with the stage on Music Hall.
[*]Fixed party members being able to join different games via the Steam server browser.
[*]Fixed bot win taunts not being synchronised between all players.
[*]Fixed being able to attack players after the game had ended.
[*]Fixed Party invites causing brief period of unresponsiveness. 
[*]Fixed some localisation issues.
[*]Fixed mouse cursor not appearing when being kicked back to the lobby.
[*]Fixed XP bar not showing divisions every 1000 points.
[*]Fixed missing audio on UI button clicks.
[*]Fixed outdated images being present in How to Play.
[*]Fixed wrong font being used on the Main Menu and How to Play screens.
[*]Fixed position of 'Start Game' button not being aligned correctly.
[*]Fixed scroll bar not appearing correctly on Player Stats screen.
[/list]
 

Happy Hunting!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i]

notes.title: Let's get this party started in Update 1.2.0!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/fff1a5bf4fb7e01529bd4efc2ffdec92c89442c1.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers,[/h1]

We're excited to share our second update with you with more content than you can shake a stick at. It's now easier than ever to get your party hats on and grab some friends to play, a ranking system to show 'em who's boss, new skins to impress that elusive Mr. X and much more! 

[h1]PATCH NOTES 1.2.0[/h1]
 
[b]FEATURES[/b]

[b]Partying[/b]

The party is on!  You can now party with up to seven friends (enemies or frenemies – who are we to judge) and join games together.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/dcc5d0abd476c4588c7a397225e00ef8fbf2ae2b.gif[/img]

[b]Kairos Rank[/b]

Prove your worth and move up the ranks, killing your fellow passengers on your way to the top! Can you become Mr. X’s most favoured ahead of every other player?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/6963950315e786756bd5df9b5ac8e1081cf3c110.png[/img]

[b]New Skins[/b]

We've added a new set of skins for each character, be the belle (or beaux) of the ball and the envy of all when you rock up in them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/1f26330ffd2862a9e3fd878d3a8df983c11cb160.gif[/img]

[b]Win Taunts[/b]

You can now choose which taunt to mock your unworthy opponents with on the winner screen, including two new unlockable taunts for each character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/0d3d9dff7fdf8e7ea21e97dcdd5e4279c6aa49ce.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/48053ffc8f6cd3f95e24d7902574bf17a9a1c901.gif[/img]
 
[b]Achievements[/b]

For all you completionists out there, we've added 44 more achievements for you to unlock. Show off your proudest achievement through our Calling Card system.

 [b]CHANGES[/b]

Connection Manager
[list]
[*]Players will now be returned to the main menu if the internet connection drops while searching for a game.
[*]Players cannot join Quick Play games when no internet connection is established.
[*]If the host loses their internet connection in a quick play game they will have their server shut down.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed player Calling Cards being displayed as bot icons on the scoreboard.
[*]Fixed sound settings applied on the Main Menu not being applied in-game.
[*]Fixed audio spam when loading into a lobby.
[*]Fixed inactivity prompt getting stuck on screen.
[*]Fixed host player not being kicked at the end of a game due to inactivity.
[*]Fixed chat not working after minimising the game window.
[*]Fixed camera movement returning after opening Chat while the Esc Menu is present.
[*]Fixed default "Resolution" option not reverting when selected.
[*]Fixed "Disable Hints" option not reverting when Back or Default settings were applied.
[*]Fixed "Player Profile" button flickering on hover-over.
[*]Fixed icons overlapping text on the failed to find a suitable private game screen.
[*]Fixed some localisation issues.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy all of the new content and we're looking forward to bringing you more updates over the next couple of months. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i]

notes.title: Calling all Murderers in Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers![/h1]

Just under a month has passed since launch… time goes fast when you’re busy carrying out Mr. X’s deeds. Today we bring you our first full update (of many to come) which makes Murderous Pursuits more accessible for our players in the East and introduces Calling Cards. We’re also continuing to squish more bugs and have made a few balancing changes within the game which you can read about below.  

We’ve been listening to you all and we appreciate the community feedback. Our goal is to allow the game to grow, have new ways for you to play and more content for you to enjoy. You’ve given us some great suggestions and we truly appreciate it. 
Thank you for your continued support and have fun!

[h1]PATCH NOTES 1.1.0[/h1]

[b]FEATURES[/b]

[b]Calling Cards[/b]
You can now equip calling cards in the player profile to show off achievements you've earned.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/f6d57f1f59f1ec130f4afb1e17e8040533b070cd.gif[/img]

[b]New Languages[/b]
We've added support for three new languages; Korean, Japanese and Chinese (Simplified).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31938275/836a5086659014194d60bd8cb4d9faa484f80bae.gif[/img]

[b]CHANGES[/b]

Main Menu
[list]
[*]Combined the various play options under one 'PLAY' sub-menu.
[*]Added pop-ups to highlight new features.
[/list]

Abilities
[list]
[*]Reveal cooldown decreased from 75 seconds to 60 seconds
[*]Riposte cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 75 seconds.
[*]Humiliate favour bonus increased from 3 favour to 5 favour.
[/list]

Exposure
[list]
[*]Increased the minimum time Exposed from 1 second to 1.5 seconds.
[/list]

Spawning
[list]
[*]Reduced the respawn time from 12 seconds to 6 seconds.
[*]Disabled the automatic showing of the scoreboard on respawn.
[*]Adjusted respawn locations so that players are more likely to spawn in a variety of locations.
[/list]

NPCs
[list]
[*]Increased the minimum and maximum moving NPCs in each level.
[*]Increased the minimum and max time that NPCs will choose to move.
[*]Increased NPC spawn chance per vignette from 50% to 75%.
[/list]

Audio
[list]
[*]Increased volume on Hunter nearby audio.
[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Quarry Tracker briefly indicating the wrong location after quarry reassignment.
[*]Fixed NPCs and bots standing too closely together in vignettes.
[*]Fixed character movement issues when opening the Steam overlay.
[*]Fixed bot names appearing as 'Bot' in the player list on the Lobby screen.
[*]Fixed issues with assigning the Esc key to different controls.
[*]Fixed collision issue with urinals.
[*]Fixed previous level played being used in a new Quick Play online lobby.
[*]Fixed character models intersecting with playing cards and harmonica.
[*]Fixed character admire animation clipping with dresser prop in Backstage.
[*]Fixed Quick Play allowing connections to LAN games.
[*]Fixed clipping through the roof on Music Hall when death camera was activated.
[*]Fixed audio playing when hovering over buttons that have no interactions present.
[*]Fixed incorrect level names being displayed in the Steam server browser.
[/list]

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[i]

notes.title: Pick Your Targets in Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Murderous Pursuers![/h1]

We hope you've been having a wonderful time stabbing away! We've been busy stamping out all the numerous bugs that are coming out of the woodwork and working hard to improve the game. We've noticed some of the niggly bugs like accidentally selecting the wrong target and have put out a fix to this - it is something we'll be looking more closely at going forward. We've also made it easier to join your friends and these bug fixes will be part of a larger update that's still to come! 

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved targeting to make it easier to see targets closely packed together and targets blocking view of other targets.
[*] Added a UI element in the Lobby to indicate the NAT status (the ability for other players to connect) of the host player. This will display either Open or Strict.
[*] Improved joining Quick Play servers so you are more likely to join a game with human players.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed targeting to exclude targets between the player character and the camera.
[*] Fixed audio looping after levelling up with player profile shown.
[*] Fixed bots not spawning in game after a host migration.
[*] Fixed chat text not having a character limit.
[*] Fixed pressing "Enter" on Join Private Game so that it joins the game.
[*] Fixed Dedicated Servers not forwarding ports with NatHelper.
[*] Fixed some UI localisation issues with non-English languages.
[/list]

Have fun!

[i]- Blazing Griffin Team[/i]
